title: Vent slot panel
prompt: Vent panel, 120 × 80 × 2 mm, centred on the origin on Z = 0, with a column of 8 identical slots cut through it: each slot 40 mm long overall along X with round ends and 4 mm wide, centred on X = 0; the first slot's centre line 12 mm above the bottom edge (Y = −28) and one every 8 mm up from there. Make the number of slots and their spacing parameters called slots and pitch.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Slots from Y = −28 every 8 mm (8 slots end at Y = 28): centroid on the panel centre
The spacing is the pitch parameter, 8 mm
hidden_tests.name: pitch

hidden_tests.description: slots = 6: the column still starts at Y = −28 (centroid moves up to y = 0.868)

notes: A 40 mm slot with round ends has its end centres 36 mm apart: area 36·4 + π·2² = 156.57 mm².
